path.description: File, directory, or glob such as src/**/*.rs (relative to the working directory, or absolute)

find.description: Show the block around the first line containing this text, then, for a definition, its references; exclusive with offset/ranges

limit.description: Max lines (default 2000; explicit values may exceed it, byte-budgeted)

ranges.description: 1-based inclusive [start, end] windows; exclusive with offset/limit

pages.description: PDF only: the 1-based pages to convert, such as "3-5,9"; the rest are left out

patch.description: Hashline patch: [path#TAG] section headers followed by PUT/CUT/REM/MV ops and +TEXT body rows

path.description: File path (absolute, or relative to the working directory)

pattern.description: Regex (Rust syntax), or an array of them matched as alternatives

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: cwd)

literal.description: Match the pattern as plain text

include.description: Glob on file paths: relative to path, or absolute

type.description: Type filter: rust, py, js, ts, md, toml, json, yaml, sh, html, css, c

block.description: Show each hit's enclosing block instead of context lines (max 20 hits per page)

def.description: Only hits on definition lines (fn, struct, class, def, …)

multiline.description: Match across lines; a hit reports its first line

replace.description: Replacement text ($1 captures); previews the diff, writes nothing

apply.description: With replace: write the previewed rewrite and tag every file

command.description: Shell command to run. Omit it to check on a background job instead.

job.description: Background job to check on; defaults to the most recent

wait.description: With command: seconds, below timeout_secs, before a still-running command becomes a background job. Without: seconds to wait for that job. Clamped 5-300.

timeout_secs.description: Wall-clock limit in seconds, default 300, ceiling 600; raise it for a build or a test suite. Past it the command is killed and reported as timed out.

max_output_lines.description: Per-call reducer line budget, for when the full output matters

symbol.description: Optional callsign or type name for the symbol-neighborhood layer

code.description: Python scratchpad code or `%%bash` shell cells to execute in the agent kernel. The kernel is Yi's own venv over the machine's site-packages: what `python3` here imports, a cell imports; a project's own venv is reached through a `%%bash` cell that runs its interpreter or runner (`uv run`, `.venv/bin/python`, `cargo`, `npm`).

question.description: What only the user can decide, in one sentence

options.description: Two to four choices, the recommended one first

default.description: The option you proceed on if the user does not answer

request.description: The request number quoted in an auto-review denial.

op.description: set replaces the whole list from a checklist; init goal+todos; append/drop/reorder/add_edge edit the cut; start/done/fail step a todo; block/unblock park one; retry a failed one; decompose a running one into a sub-plan; supersede replaces the whole cut; view echoes it; accepted_by_user asks the user, or the classifier in auto mode, to close a todo whose check cannot run here

list.description: set: the checklist, one `- [ ] label` per line (`[>]` running, `[x]` done), nested by two-space indent; trailing `user://<n>` tokens cite the user's messages the row serves

plan.description: Sub-plan id; omit for the root plan

goal.description: init: the whole deliverable in one line

todos.description: init/append/decompose/supersede: the todos. A delegation hands the todo to a child and its accept is mandatory; isolation worktree requires a contract, as does container:<image>, the same worktree with its bash run in a container of that image; done runs the contract

label.description: the todo's name, imperative, at most 80 chars

after.description: labels of the todos this one waits on

intent.description: user://<n> of each user message it serves; default the latest

waived.description: [{address, reason}]: a user message the plan leaves unserved

delegation.description: {spec: {role?, model?, effort?, isolation?}, accept: {command} | {stated}, context?: [url], output?: {schema: url}}

contract.description: what must hold when the todo is done; done runs its items and passes at the threshold

class.description: writer needs a critical cmd or example item, reader a critical schema item, inline either

covers.description: globs whose writes preview the cmd items

threshold.description: thousandths of the decided weight that must pass; default 1000

min_coverage.description: thousandths of the whole weight that must decide rather than abstain; default 1000

id.description: the item's name, unique in the contract

critical.description: a failed critical item fails the todo, an abstaining one holds it

weight.description: the item's share of the score

decider.description: {cmd: "shell command that exits 0 only when the item holds"}, or {cmd: {checker: command, timeout_ms}} (default and ceiling 600000); {schema: {schema: artifact}}; {example: {cases: artifact, runner: artifact, timeout_ms}}; an artifact is {digest, media_type, length}

labels.description: reorder: every label of the plan, in the new priority order

after.description: add_edge: the sibling it waits on

on.description: block: {"child": agent} | {"user": null} | {"external": {"probe": command}} | {"channel": {"address": "clock://at <ISO time>" or an exec://, file:// or channel:// address as in todo, "filter"?}}, unblocked by the first match

note.description: block: what would unblock it; accepted_by_user: the check you ran by hand and its exit line

options.description: block on user: 3 to 5 answers [{id, label, preview?}] the user picks one of by replying with its number, id or label; a preview is light (a line, a small diagram's source, or an address), at most 2048 bytes

output.description: done: url of the product; required when the delegation declares an output schema

delegation.description: retry: replacement delegation, shaped as in todos

reason.description: supersede: why the cut is wrong

full.description: view: every todo instead of counts plus the frontier

op.description: done/drop/rm also take a phase, or nothing for all

list.description: set: the checklist; trailing `user://<n>` tokens on a row cite the user messages it serves

items.description: init (flat, one phase) or append: labels to add

phase.description: append: the phase (created if missing); done/drop/rm: every item in it

under.description: append: the parent label the items nest under

id.description: start/done/drop/block/unblock/rm: the item's id, e.g. t3; or use label

evidence.description: done: the command in backticks and the output line that proves it

reason.description: drop: why the item no longer applies

on.description: block: who it waits on: user, external, child, or an address: `clock://at <ISO time>`, `exec://<command>?every=30s`, `file://<path>`, `channel://<name>`; the first message matching `filter` unblocks it

filter.description: block: `key=value&…` matched exactly, or a substring; `ok=true` waits for an exec to pass

options.description: block on user: 3 to 5 answers [{id, label, preview?}] the user picks one of by number, id or label; a preview is light, at most 2048 bytes

touched.description: optional: the touched counter you last saw; a stale value is refused so a user edit is never overwritten
